organisation.hint: Everything on this page belongs to the selected organisation.

overview.heading: Policy documents

status.label: Status
status.noMoves: No next steps are possible from this status.

descriptions.analyse: Map the existing policy and frameworks.
descriptions.bespreken: Discuss the draft and have it reviewed.

chapters.heading: Chapters
chapters.draft: Have the advisor write this chapter
chapters.draftReady: Draft ready. Review it and save if it is correct.

documents.title: Documents
documents.subtitle: Upload the source documents. The advisor answers only from these.
documents.heading: Add a document
documents.fieldTitleHint: This is how the document is named in answers.
documents.fileHint: PDF or Word (.docx). Up to 100 MB.
documents.noText: No text was found in this file. Is it a scan without a text layer?

advisor.title: Digital procurement advisor
advisor.subtitle: Ask your question. The answer comes from this organisation's own documents.
advisor.question: Your question
advisor.questionPlaceholder: How many quotes do I need for a € 30,000 cleaning contract?
advisor.asking: The advisor is looking it up…
advisor.noSources: No sources found. Add documents under Documents first.
advisor.ungrounded: Note: no document excerpts were found, so this answer is not grounded in your documents.
advisor.example1: How many quotes do I need for a € 30,000 cleaning contract?
advisor.example2: Who may sign a € 40,000 real-estate assignment?
advisor.example3: What does comply-or-explain mean in our procurement policy?

check.title: Check a purchase
check.subtitle: Enter the amount and the type of purchase. You get the procedure, the number of quotes, and who may sign.
check.amountHint: The whole contract, not one year. For an annual contract, enter the yearly amount and choose "per year".
check.mandateNone: No role may sign this amount on its own.
check.noThreshold: This organisation has no threshold tier covering this amount.

requirement.vastleggen_offerteaanvraag: Record the request for quotation and the quote(s)
requirement.strategie_en_gunningsadvies: Produce a procurement strategy and an award-advice document

obligation.recurring_multiplier_applied: Recurring contract: the yearly amount was multiplied by 4 to determine the contract value.
obligation.advisor_required: The procurement advisor must be involved in this purchase.
obligation.supervisory_board_approval: Above € 1,000,000: advance approval from the Supervisory Board is required.
obligation.contract_register: This commitment must be entered in the central contract register.
obligation.anti_splitting: A purchase may not be split up to stay under a threshold. Assess total spend per supplier or category, not a single order.
obligation.no_mandate_covers: No role holds a mandate for this amount. Escalate to the board.
obligation.no_threshold_matches: No threshold tier was found for this amount.

deviations.title: Comply or explain
deviations.subtitle: Deviating from the procurement rules? Record here what you skipped and why.
deviations.heading: Record a deviation
deviations.subject: What is this about
deviations.subjectPlaceholder: For example: emergency roof repair, Vogelbuurt
deviations.justification: Why was the rule not followed
deviations.justificationHint: This is the heart of comply-or-explain. Write it so an auditor still understands it a year from now. At least 20 characters.
